title: Men's Baseball: The Whole Road to College
title_html:
Men's Baseball:
The Whole Road to College
rules_checked: 11 November 2026, against the NCAA rule text, the printed Division I calendar, the NAIA handbook and the NJCAA signing chart
levels: D1 and D2 and D3 and NAIA and junior college
kicker: Baseball · boys and men · grades 9 to 12 · sport playbook
sub: What to do, when to do it, who pays, and what a coach is and is not allowed to tell you. Built from the 2026-27 NCAA rule text, the printed Division I recruiting calendar, the NAIA and junior college rule books, and the 2026 draft results.
edge: NCAA baseball fields 940 teams across three divisions, and 127 high school seniors were picked in the 2026 draft out of the 472,598 who played in the latest counted high school year. Many families pay for exposure before they learn the two things a staff actually uses. Those two are a schedule of events a coach can watch, and the dates he is allowed to answer.

site.blurb: The draft rule that sets a boy’s whole calendar, how much aid a school may put on a roster, where a boy is actually seen, film, paperwork, and what the money really goes to.
site.outcome: A plan by date for grades 9 to 12. When a coach may call, text or meet him, each with the rule behind it. The money math before a family spends.
